requirements: A PDF reader (for PDF scores) or notation software (for .mscz / .musicxml sources)
For printing: an A4 printer and paper
steps: Download the score file and confirm its format
Open PDFs with any reader; open source files in the matching notation software
Adjust print scaling as needed, or transpose in software before playing
notes: Source files can be transposed and edited in notation software; PDFs are best used as printed.
safety: Scores are for personal study and performance
Check the author's stated license before redistributing or performing publicly
